file: CWE-829-walk-packages-safe.py

import importlib
import pkgutil


def import_all():
    for package in (_pytest, packaging):
        for module in pkgutil.walk_packages(package.__path__, f"{package.__name__}."):
            try:
                importlib.import_module(module.name)
            except ImportError:
                pass
